title: Link batch answer
description: The body a gateway's 2xx to a link batch may carry, application/json: on the local link unsigned, behind a separate gateway signed as every answer on a bound connection (README §The gateway's link). An empty body, or one without stop, means the session goes on. With stop, the session stops the runtime as at the run's time limit and writes dev.qory.session.exited, cancelled, with stop.reason as its reason. A member Forager does not recognise is ignored.

stop.description: Why the session stops its runtime. The run stays open.

reason.description: model_key_limit: the gateway's proxy passed a model provider's limit refusal to the session, because no key of the key group is left, or the refused request's body was over the 8 MiB the gateway copies for a resend (README §Credentials, Several model keys).
